items.scene: A developer explains two-factor authentication to a new hire who has never used it before.
items.question: Which option is best calibrated to the listener?
options: You enter your password and then type the code sent to your phone.
The flow uses TOTP, device binding, and session rotation.
You should already know this, so I will skip it.
Let me persuade you to care about account security.
items.why_this_case_matters: Direct fit to a novice listener by lowering jargon and giving a clear basic example.

items.scene: A volunteer explains a tax proposal to skeptical voters.
items.question: Which option is best calibrated to the listener?
options: This plan will definitely make you support us, because it is the smart choice.
Here is how the proposal changes deductions, in plain terms, so you can judge it.
I will hint at the benefits without explaining the details.
You are probably too biased to understand the policy.
items.why_this_case_matters: Tests the shortcut of mistaking persuasion for audience fit; the plain explanation is calibrated, while the persuasive framing is not.

items.scene: A manager speaks to a new colleague from another country about a holiday schedule.
items.question: Which option is best calibrated to the listener?
options: If you do not celebrate this holiday, I can explain the schedule without assuming shared customs.
I will avoid mentioning the holiday at all so I do not offend you.
You people probably do not understand our customs.
I need you to agree with our holiday plan.
items.why_this_case_matters: Close to the boundary with tact, but the key issue is identity-aware explanation, not offense avoidance.

items.scene: A doctor explains a treatment to a patient's parent who has no medical training.
items.question: Which option is best calibrated to the listener?
options: The regimen includes BID dosing and monitoring for adverse events.
It is a way to help, and I will not explain the details.
It is a medicine taken twice a day, and I will explain the side effects in everyday language.
You should trust me and not ask questions.
items.why_this_case_matters: Checks listener-fit by matching explanation depth to a novice's knowledge level.
